definitions.explanation: The region of the atmosphere above the earth.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げる→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧。
examples.english: To look up at the sky.
Stars are visible in the night sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}んで→止む：01153_yamu⟧{空|そら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦なってきた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The rain stopped and the sky brightened up.

notes:
{空|そら} means sky—the visible expanse above the earth.

KANJI READINGS:
The kanji has multiple readings with different meanings:
- {空|そら}: sky (native Japanese reading)
- {空|から}: empty (e.g., ⟦{空|から}っぽ→からっぽ：02354_karappo⟧ = empty)
- {空|くう}: void, emptiness (Sino-Japanese, Buddhist)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{青空|あおぞら}→青空：10084_aozora⟧: blue sky
- ⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧: night sky
- ⟦{大空|おおぞら}→大空：25275_oozora⟧: the great sky, heavens
- ⟦{空模様|そらもよう}→空模様：19362_soramoyou⟧: sky conditions, weather
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧: airport
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: air, atmosphere
- ⟦{空中|くうちゅう}→空中：21842_kuuchuu⟧: in the air, midair

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {空|そら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げる→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧: to look up at the sky
- {空|そら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曇|くも}る→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧: the sky becomes cloudy
- {空|そら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧: the sky clears up

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{天|てん}→天：noentry⟧: heaven, sky (more literary)
- ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧: cloud
- ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧: star
